name: Frozen Shutter
intent: The batch's first hard level, and the first to put the frozen board together with both kinds of blindness. The camera is iced over and wants 40 white; white is the gear's 108-pixel rim, the magnet's north pole and the bulb's glint, 132 pixels on open boards, and the containers are 33 each, so the ice takes two finished white containers rather than one - the player has to commit to white early and keep committing. Behind the ice sits the camera's 87-pixel brown body, hidden as mystery pixels: brown exists nowhere else in the level, so every brown container is a slot held until the thaw, and even then the player cannot see what they are digging into. The gear's black hub is the second hidden group, and black's only visible home is the bulb's six-pixel base, so black is the level's planned clog. Everything else is deliberately fair: red, yellow, purple and cyan all have exposed homes from the first move, and the orange filament is five pixels the player can plan around once they notice it.
label: hard
